_comment: Single registry of products published through ajjs1ajjs/dist. When adding a product: 1) add entry here, 2) add card to dist index.html + SITE public/index.html (accepted design), 3) add prefix to SITE scripts/sync-versions.mjs CONFIG, 4) add prefix to release-retention.yml PREFIXES. scripts/sync-hub.mjs --check-catalog verifies all four stay in sync.
